entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I hope you can help. I'm trying to make a return, and the website is just so confusing. I think... I have a helmet I need to send back.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your order number?

Sure, it's uh... VF-8675309. It's the Trail Helmet. The color just wasn't right when it arrived. The box is still unopened and everything. I'm just... I'm not good with these things. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Please don't worry, we'll sort this out together. I'm pulling up your order now. One moment.
Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet, delivered about 30 days ago. Let me quickly check our policy for you.
And... yes, great news! Standard items like this helmet are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. We can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. Getting the right gear is crucial, especially for safety. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account right now. And since you're a VIP member, I've gone ahead and waived any restocking fees.
Wow, that's really nice of you. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so much easier.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
